craft.collapse: ONE ATTRIBUTION FRAME. Not one sentence twelve times — the content genuinely varies and the best of it is very good — but one construction, and it is what the reader meets first every time. Measured over the 28 faces: 27 of 28 carry the verb 'say' or 'says', and it is the pool's only attribution verb (ruling 20 vetoes the same verb three times running; variant 3 runs nine of nine with no break, variant 2 eight of nine). 24 of 28 are subject-first, the source in the grammatical subject slot; the four breaks are variant 1's guild (attribution last) and the three tavern faces (place first). 13 of 28 land the identical tail, '[Source] says A, and that B'. 244 distinct words over 749, with three or four nouns carrying the pool ('the line' alone 15 times). The draft's own NOTES §4 reaches the same finding honestly and calls it a supply problem rather than an ordering one — variants 2 and 3 run 4/4 in one opener class, exceeding ruling 36, and no permutation of the candidates offered fixes it. I agree with that diagnosis, and it is why this is DULL at the pool rather than a set of per-face notes: the fix is upstream of the selector. WHAT IS NOT WRONG AND MUST SURVIVE THE CURE: ten distinct speakers, every one seated by a row the card prints, each carrying an interest the town's own fields give it; real stake, genuinely unsettled (the hall defends its purse, the watch has a grievance, the guilds pay and get nothing, the households owe work, a stranger cannot get a straight answer), with two pairs that actually disagree; and strong particulars — the tallow on the bar, the grain leaving the line to be ground and coming back through the same gap, the carrying falling on the finder, the bed inside the line nobody haggles over, the stalls down while there is light. This pool is decisively NOT duller than the three shipped rows it replaces, which say 'a chokepoint on paper' and 'long stretches of good work' and nothing about anybody. THE CURE IS A WRITER'S BRIEF, NOT A RE-SELECTION: ask by name, at a stated rate per variant, for frames the packets never supplied — attribution last (the pool has exactly one and it is variant 1's best line); attribution embedded mid-sentence; object-fronted; a reported custom with no speech verb at all (variant 2's tavern is the one specimen); and ruling 23's compound pair-joint, which lets the second attribution ride inside the sentence and breaks the subject-first run for free. A synonym for 'says' is not the fix — ruling 20 bars the mannered verb and the collapse is in the frame, not the word. PLUS THE ECHO ROW (craft, at the face): a spine co-renders with every face of its variant, and variant 1's spine predicate 'the works are kept up' is repeated VERBATIM in faces 2 and 3, so two of the ten units that variant renders stammer one sentence in; variant 2 spends 'the way through' in the spine and in three of nine faces (forced vocabulary, the lesser fault, but the spine need not spend it); variant 3 echoes 'company' into face 7. Also two bare-assertion faults reported not charged (ruling 40): variant 1 face 4 and variant 2 face 6 each attribute sentence one and then state an unrecorded consequence in the archiver's bare hand.
